title: Steak with mushrooms, green beans and salad
steps: Take the steak out of the fridge 15 minutes before cooking, pat it dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a heavy pan or grill until very hot and cook the steak for 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium (less for rare, more for well done). Rest it on a plate for 5 minutes.
In the same pan, fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil with crushed garlic for 4 to 5 minutes until golden.
Steam or boil the green beans for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender. Slice the tomato and tear the lettuce.
Trim any fat, slice the steak across the grain and serve it with the mushrooms, beans and salad.
